source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 3ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Δάσιος, Σέβηρος, Άνδρωνας, Θεόδοτος και Θεοδότη»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 3 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and the whole notice is one sentence. The entry enumerates five, so it is five folders. The display name takes the day because the page gives no epithet, no city and no year, and the corpus already keeps thirteen Theodotuses — of Ancyra, of Cyzicus, of Ephesus, of Kyrenia, of Marcianopolis and the rest. The corpus's «theodote-companion-of-theodotus» is a different pair on a different day. No `dates` object, no location. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (1 October 2026).
